# Intellivra Global

> Intellivra Global is an IT staffing and consulting firm that provides pre-vetted engineering talent and delivery teams to US enterprises.

Intellivra Global works with US enterprises that need engineering capacity faster than an internal
recruiting cycle can deliver it. Every consultant passes a four-stage screen - AI-assisted skills
matching, a live interview with a practising engineer, a work-sample review, and employment plus
reference verification - before a client ever sees the profile. Roughly one applicant in fourteen
reaches submission.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Intellivra Global LLC
- Founded: 2021
- Company size: 51-200 employees
- Headquarters: Allen, TX, United States
- Delivery centre: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Business hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 7:00 PM US Central Time
- Engagement models: staff augmentation, contract, contract-to-hire, direct placement, managed teams under a statement of work
- Median time from approved job description to shortlist: 48 hours
- Direct placement fee: 18-22 percent of first-year base salary
- Replacement guarantee: 30 days for contract placements, 90 days for direct placements
- Worker classifications supported: W2, corp-to-corp (C2C), 1099

## Services

- [IT Staff Augmentation](https://intellivraglobal.com/services.html#staff-augmentation): Pre-vetted engineers added to an existing in-house team on an hourly bill rate, under the client's own management. Three-month minimum, 30-day replacement guarantee.
- [Contract & Contract-to-Hire](https://intellivraglobal.com/services.html#contract-hire): Consultants on Intellivra Global payroll with no conversion fee after six months of billing. W2, corp-to-corp and 1099; H-1B transfer, OPT and CPT supported.
- [Direct Placement](https://intellivraglobal.com/services.html#direct-placement): Permanent hiring billed at 18-22 percent of first-year base salary, with a 90-day replacement guarantee. Contingent by default, retained on request.
- [AI & Data Engineering Solutions](https://intellivraglobal.com/services.html#ai-data): Lakehouse and warehouse builds, streaming and batch pipelines, feature stores, RAG and LLM applications with evaluation harnesses and model risk documentation.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://intellivraglobal.com/services.html#cloud-devops): AWS, Azure and GCP landing zones, Terraform module libraries, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD golden paths, observability and SLOs, and FinOps cost work.
- [Managed Teams](https://intellivraglobal.com/services.html#managed-teams): An outcome-based delivery pod with a named lead, priced per sprint or milestone under a statement of work. Onshore, blended or offshore with four-hour overlap.

## Industries served

- [Healthcare](https://intellivraglobal.com/industries.html#healthcare): Payers, providers and health tech. HIPAA, HL7, FHIR, Epic and Cerner, OIG exclusion screening.
- [Banking, Financial Services & Insurance](https://intellivraglobal.com/industries.html#bfsi): Core banking and payments, fraud and AML analytics, model risk management, PCI DSS and SOX scope.
- [Retail & E-commerce](https://intellivraglobal.com/industries.html#retail): Order management, personalisation, demand forecasting and peak-season readiness.
- [Manufacturing](https://intellivraglobal.com/industries.html#manufacturing): MES and ERP integration, IIoT telemetry, predictive maintenance, OT and IT boundary work.
- [Energy & Utilities](https://intellivraglobal.com/industries.html#energy): Meter data platforms, outage and asset analytics, generation forecasting, NERC CIP awareness.
- [Technology & SaaS](https://intellivraglobal.com/industries.html#technology): Product engineering pods, platform hardening, developer experience and QA automation.
